Definition
[Limit set and elementary group] \group Kleinian groupsSource: thurston:page-0186 For a discrete group $\Gamma $ of orientation-preserving isometries of $H^n$, the limit set $L_\Gamma \subset S^{n-1}_\infty $ is the accumulation set of any orbit $\Gamma x$. It is independent of $x$. The group is elementary when $\abs {L_\Gamma }\leq 2$.
